content: फल्गु {%a.%} [फल्-उ गुक् च <ls>Uṇ. 1. 18</ls>] .²1 Pithless, unessential; unsubstantial; सारं ततो ग्राह्यमपास्य फल्गु <ls>Pt. 1</ls>. .²2 Worthless, useless, unimportant; ‘फल्गु तुच्छमसारं च’ <ls>Yādava.</ls>; तरीषु तत्रत्यमफल्गु भाण्डम् <ls>Śi. 3. 76</ls>. .²3 Small, minute; नामरूपविभेदेन फल्ग्व्या च कलया कृताः <ls>Bhāg. 8. 3. 22</ls>. .²4 Vain, unmeaning. .²5 Weak, feeble, flimsy; फल्गूनि तत्र महतां जीवो जीवस्य जीवनम् <ls>Bhāg. 1. 13. 47</ls>. .²6 Untrue. .²7 Beautiful, lovely. .{@-ल्गुः@} {%f.%} .²1 The spring season. .²2 The opposite-leaved fig-tree (<lang>Mar.</lang> <ns>बोखाडा</ns>). .²3 <ab>N.</ab> of a river at Gayā. .²4 A red powder of wild ginger (<lang>Mar.</lang> <ns>गुलाल</ns>) thrown by the Hindus over one another at the Holi festival. .²5 (<ab>du.</ab>) (In <ab>astrol.</ab>) <ab>N.</ab> of a नक्षत्र.
